item.title: Generative AI Train the Trainer Session - Microsoft LEAP
item.description:
👩‍🏫 When a teacher gives you Kudos, you know teaching was always your calling!

I always find it so wholesome collaborating with Microsoft LEAP because teaching is where my heart is. While getting kudos is always nice, the real impact comes from seeing people’s faces light up as they discover something new that alone makes it all worth it.

Adding AI to education….

This blog post will be brief, I originally wrote it as a recap, but honestly, the session itself was so wholesome that I don’t have much to add.
